name: Social / Instagram Profile
description: Vertical-friendly short-form storytelling with a fast hook and retention beats.

stages.story: Open with a clear hook, preserve the creator voice and resolve the promise quickly.
stages.scene_direction: Plan vertical-safe framing, readable captions, rapid but coherent beats and a strong ending.
stages.image: Keep the subject centered in a safe vertical crop with expressive, immediately readable composition.
stages.audio: Prioritize intelligible speech, beat-synced music and brief accent effects without overwhelming the voice.
stages.video: Use energetic but motivated movement, captions-safe framing and short transitions.
stages.review: Check hook clarity, retention beats, crop safety, caption space, pacing and creator identity.
